title: AI Assistant — Agentic Coding Cheat Sheet
brandSub: AI Chat · Coding Agents · Code Completion · MCP · BYOK

rows.label: Install plugin
rows.value: Search AI Assistant in Settings | Plugins | Marketplace — not bundled by default

rows.label: Supported IDEs
rows.value: IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, CLion, GoLand, Rider, WebStorm, PhpStorm, RubyMine, RustRover, DataGrip, DataSpell

rows.label: Min IDE version
rows.value: 2023.3 (Community Editions 2024.1.1+; AI Free tier requires 2025.1+)

rows.label: Open AI Chat
rows.value: Click the AI Chat button on the right toolbar; or assign a shortcut in Settings | Keymap | Tool Windows | AI Assistant

rows.label: 30-day trial
rows.value: Click Start Free Trial in the AI Chat tool window — links a payment card but charges nothing during the trial

rows.label: Activation path
rows.value: Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Providers & API keys — JetBrains AI, BYOK, OAuth, or ACP agent

rows.label: Disable for project
rows.value: Click JetBrains AI widget → Disable AI Assistant → Disable for This Project; or create .noai in project root

rows.label: Cloud Agents
rows.value: Run coding agents in isolated cloud environment; results written to a separate branch — JetBrains Central orgs only

rows.label: Insights (Exp.)
rows.value: Auto-generates brief summaries for hard-to-read code segments; marked with insight icon in editor — install AI Assistant Experimental Features plugin

rows.label: Recap (Exp.)
rows.value: Summarises recent work in Recap tool window; auto-updates after configurable inactivity period (default 5 min)

rows.label: Group with AI (Exp.)
rows.value: Groups committed / uncommitted diffs by impact (high / medium / low) in Commit & VCS log tool windows

rows.label: Junie Debug mode
rows.value: AI-powered debugger in IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate — manages breakpoints, inspects runtime state without editing code; requires MCP Server & Debugger MCP Toolset plugins

rows.label: ACP agents
rows.value: Connect any ACP-compatible external agent without a JetBrains AI subscription; install from registry or configure ~/.jetbrains/acp.json

rows.label: Next edit suggestions
rows.value: AI predicts next likely edit; press Tab to jump to suggestion, Tab again to apply — not available on AI Free tier

rows.label: /explain
rows.value: Explains a mentioned file, symbol, or selection directly in chat

rows.label: /refactor
rows.value: Suggests refactoring for the code selected in the editor

rows.label: /web
rows.value: Searches the internet and returns answer + source links

rows.label: /docs
rows.value: Searches IDE documentation; links to the relevant setting or page

rows.label: /commands
rows.value: Lists all slash commands available in the current session or agent context

rows.label: /help
rows.value: Provides information about AI Chat features

rows.label: New chat
rows.value: ⌘N — start a fresh conversation; switch mode anytime with ⌘/

rows.label: Apply to file
rows.value: Click Apply on a code snippet → review diff with Next/Previous Change → Accept All or Discard All

rows.label: @thisFile
rows.value: Attaches the currently open file to the chat request

rows.label: @selection
rows.value: Attaches the code currently selected in the editor

rows.label: @file: / @folder:
rows.value: Attach a specific file or entire folder; also supports drag-and-drop into chat

rows.label: @localChanges
rows.value: Attaches all current uncommitted VCS changes

rows.label: @commit:
rows.value: Attaches a specific commit reference by hash

rows.label: @symbol:
rows.value: Attaches a named symbol, e.g. @symbol:MyClass

rows.label: @dbObject:
rows.value: Attaches a database schema or table to improve SQL generation — DataGrip / DB Tools plugin, IDE 2025.2+

rows.label: @rule:
rows.value: Inlines a Project Rule into the prompt; also invokable via Add attachment

rows.label: Codebase Mode
rows.value: On by default — automatically gathers relevant project context; respects .gitignore & .aiignore; toggle via chat settings

rows.label: Accept full suggestion
rows.value: Tab (configurable) — accepts the entire inline suggestion

rows.label: Accept word-by-word
rows.value: ⌥→ — accept one word at a time

rows.label: Accept line-by-line
rows.value: ⌘→ — accept one line at a time

rows.label: Reject suggestion
rows.value: Esc — dismiss the current suggestion

rows.label: Trigger manually
rows.value: ⌥⇧\ — force a completion request even mid-token

rows.label: Completion policy
rows.value: Focused (default) / Balanced / Creative — configure in Settings | Editor | Code Completion | Inline

rows.label: Default model
rows.value: JetBrains Mellum for inline completion; configurable via Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Providers & API keys | AI Completion

rows.label: Completions in
rows.value: Editor, AI Chat input, commit messages, code comments — per-language control in Settings

rows.label: Prompt in editor
rows.value: ⌘\ on empty line → generate new code; on selection → modify selected code

rows.label: AI Actions menu
rows.value: ⌥↩ → AI Actions — context-aware actions: Explain Code, Find Problems, Generate Tests, Write Docs, Suggest Refactoring

rows.label: Generate unit tests
rows.value: Right-click → AI Actions → Generate Unit Tests; opens AI Diff tab; click Specify to add requirements

rows.label: Write documentation
rows.value: Right-click declaration → AI Actions → Write Documentation; type /** (Java/Kotlin) then Enter for inline trigger

rows.label: AI name suggestions
rows.value: Rename (⇧F6) — AI suggests names based on symbol contents; toggle in Settings | Tools | AI Assistant

rows.label: Explain error
rows.value: Click Explain with AI next to any runtime, build, or SQL error in console or Problems view

rows.label: Convert pasted code
rows.value: Paste cross-language code → AI detects mismatch and offers Convert — enable in Settings | Tools | AI Assistant

rows.label: Junie
rows.value: JetBrains' own agent — plans & executes multi-step tasks; requires JetBrains AI subscription; respects .aiignore

rows.label: Brave Mode (Junie)
rows.value: Toggle Brave Mode switch in chat input — skips confirmation prompts for file edits and commands; use with caution

rows.label: /ide, /usage, /remote
rows.value: Junie-specific commands: check IDE connection, view token-cost breakdown, start browser-accessible remote session at air.jetbrains.cloud

rows.label: Claude Agent
rows.value: Anthropic's agent — modes: Auto, Default, Accept Edits, Plan, Don't Ask, Bypass; reads CLAUDE.md; Fast mode toggle available

rows.label: Codex
rows.value: OpenAI's agent — modes: Read-only, Agent, Agent (full access); reads AGENTS.md; use $skill-installer to add curated skills

rows.label: GitHub Copilot
rows.value: Activated via GitHub OAuth only; modes: Agent, Plan, Autopilot; reads AGENTS.md & CLAUDE.md

rows.label: Rollback
rows.value: Hover a changed file in agent pane → click revert icon; or click Rollback to undo all agent changes

rows.label: Reasoning level
rows.value: Select per-agent reasoning depth (Low → High) — higher quality on complex tasks, longer processing time

rows.label: AGENTS.md
rows.value: Instruction file read by Junie, Codex, and GitHub Copilot — place in project root for version-controlled, team-wide guidance

rows.label: CLAUDE.md
rows.value: Instruction file read by Claude Agent and GitHub Copilot — same purpose and placement as AGENTS.md

rows.label: Skills — install
rows.value: Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Skills — install at IDE, Project, or per-agent level (Claude Agent & Codex)

rows.label: Invoke skill
rows.value: Type $skill-name in chat to invoke explicitly; agents also trigger relevant skills automatically

rows.label: /skills
rows.value: Codex command — lists skills currently available in the session

rows.label: External registries
rows.value: Add GitHub repository URL under Manage External Registries to browse and install published skills

rows.label: /ij-debugger
rows.value: Debugger MCP skill for Claude Code / Codex; copy with Copy Debugger Skills to Agents action in Search Everywhere

rows.label: Add MCP server
rows.value: Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Model Context Protocol (MCP) → click Add → paste JSON config; supports STDIO & Streamable HTTP

rows.label: STDIO config
rows.value: {"mcpServers":{"name":{"command":"node","args":["path/to/server"]}}}

rows.label: HTTP config
rows.value: {"mcpServers":{"name":{"url":"https://example.com/mcp"}}}

rows.label: Import from Claude
rows.value: Click Import from Claude on the MCP settings page to reuse Claude Desktop's server configs

rows.label: IDE as MCP server
rows.value: IDEs 2025.2+ bundle an MCP Server plugin exposing code analysis, file, VCS, terminal & debugger tools to external clients (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code)

rows.label: Perforce MCP
rows.value: Configure at Settings | Version Control | Perforce | Perforce MCP to give AI access to changelists, workspaces & server info

rows.label: MCP tools in chat
rows.value: MCP-exposed tools appear as / commands; agents invoke them automatically or you can call them explicitly by name

rows.label: Model picker
rows.value: Click model name in AI Chat to switch; set to Auto for best performance/cost balance

rows.label: Reasoning models
rows.value: Marked with brain icon — better for multi-step logic; high-cost models marked with ruby icon

rows.label: BYOK providers
rows.value: Anthropic, Google (Gemini API or Vertex AI), OpenAI, OpenAI-compatible, Ollama, LM Studio — configure in Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Providers & API keys

rows.label: Local models
rows.value: Ollama / LM Studio: specify base URL in Providers settings; default context window 64 000 tokens (configurable)

rows.label: Custom completion model
rows.value: Set OpenAI-compatible FIM or edit-prediction model for code completion under AI Completion section in Providers settings

rows.label: Model assignment
rows.value: Core features and Instant helpers model slots under Model Assignment — for local/OpenAI-compatible endpoints only

rows.label: Enable JB AI + BYOK
rows.value: Click Activate JetBrains AI in Providers settings to combine BYOK with JetBrains AI as fallback for unsupported features

rows.label: Generate commit msg
rows.value: ⌘0 → click Generate Commit Message icon; customise prompt via gear icon → AI Assistant | Prompt for generation

rows.label: Self-review
rows.value: Commit tool window → select changes → Self-Review with AI; shows issues with quick-fix options in Problems tool window

rows.label: Self-review guidelines
rows.value: Set a Markdown guidelines file at Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Project Settings | Path to rules for AI Self-Review

rows.label: Explain commit
rows.value: VCS log → right-click commit(s) → Explain Commit with AI Assistant

rows.label: PR / MR title + desc
rows.value: In the PR creation dialog click Generate a Title and Description with AI Assistant

rows.label: Resolve conflicts
rows.value: Merge Revisions dialog → click Merge with AI — auto-merges conflicting & non-conflicting hunks

rows.label: Auto shelf title
rows.value: Shelve Silently (⌘⇧H) — AI generates shelf name automatically; disable in Settings | Tools | AI Assistant

rows.label: Group with AI
rows.value: Commit tool window or VCS log → Group with AI — clusters diffs into high/medium/low impact groups (Experimental Features plugin)

rows.label: Create rule
rows.value: Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Rules → New Project Rules File — creates .aiassistant/rules/<name>.md

rows.label: Rule types
rows.value: Always, Manually, By model decision, By file patterns, Off — set per rule file in the editor

rows.label: Invoke rule in chat
rows.value: Type @rule:rule-name in chat, or add via Add attachment for Manually-typed rules

rows.label: Chat instructions
rows.value: Modify the Chat Instructions built-in prompt in Prompt Library — auto-appended to every new chat

rows.label: Custom prompts
rows.value: Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Prompt Library → click +; appears in AI Actions menu; use $SELECTION variable

rows.label: Modify built-in prompt
rows.value: Select any built-in action in Prompt Library (e.g. Commit Message Generation) and add instructions below the defaults

rows.label: Save from chat
rows.value: Hover a sent message → click ⋯ → Save Current Prompt to add it directly to the Prompt Library

rows.label: AI Free
rows.value: 3 AI Credits / 30 days — free; no next edit suggestions; not available in Community Editions or Android Studio

rows.label: AI Pro
rows.value: 10 AI Credits / 30 days — $10/month individual; includes all features & top-up capability

rows.label: AI Ultimate
rows.value: 35 AI Credits / 30 days — $30/month individual; 70 credits for org per-user; top-up supported

rows.label: Top-up Credits
rows.value: Purchase additional credits via JetBrains AI widget or JetBrains Account; valid 12 months; used only after monthly quota exhausted

rows.label: JB Central pool
rows.value: Orgs on JetBrains Central share a credit pool; admin controls per-user limits; monthly credits accumulate, expire after 1 year

rows.label: Track usage
rows.value: JetBrains AI widget in window header → progress bar shows credits left; reset date shown below bar

rows.label: Reduce quota burn
rows.value: Start new chats per topic; prefer cheaper models; avoid long agent sessions with expensive reasoning models

rows.label: .aiignore
rows.value: Same syntax as .gitignore; restricts AI Assistant & Junie from processing listed files; also honours .cursorignore & .codeiumignore

rows.label: .aiignore scope
rows.value: Respected: Junie. Not respected: Claude Agent, Codex, GitHub Copilot — keep sensitive files in mind

rows.label: Data sharing opt-in
rows.value: Settings | Appearance & Behavior | System Settings | Data Sharing | Send detailed code-related data — disabled by default

rows.label: Request log
rows.value: Search Everywhere → Open AI Assistant Requests Log in Editor — opens ai-assistant-requests.md for the current session

rows.label: Network block
rows.value: Block https://api.jetbrains.ai/ and https://api.app.prod.grazie.aws.intellij.net/ to disable at network level

rows.label: Trusted domains
rows.value: Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Trusted Domains — links to listed domains open without confirmation dialogs

rows.label: Message trimming
rows.value: Configure context window threshold % at Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Message Trimming Threshold to avoid oversized requests
On empty line: prompt to generate code; on selection: prompt to modify code
Open AI Actions context menu on selection or caret
Switch between Chat mode and last selected agent

rows.label: ⌘N (chat)
rows.value: Start a new chat conversation

rows.label: ⌘F (chat)
rows.value: Search within the current chat; or search chat history list
Maximize / restore the AI Chat tool window
Manually trigger inline cloud code completion

rows.label: ⌘R (editor)
rows.value: Regenerate the last in-editor AI suggestion

rows.label: /plot
rows.value: Jupyter: generate visualization code for a dataframe — e.g. /plot #df histogram of x with legend (PyCharm Pro & DataSpell)

rows.label: @jupyter:
rows.value: Attaches a Jupyter variable to chat context, e.g. @jupyter:df

rows.label: Jupyter Fix Cell
rows.value: Right-click failing cell → AI Fix Cell; or Accept and Run to apply & execute generated fix immediately

rows.label: Text-to-SQL
rows.value: Ask an agent in natural language; database-text-to-sql skill introspects live schema before generating the query (DataGrip)

rows.label: Explain query plan
rows.value: Run Explain Plan on a query → click Analyze SQL Plan with AI on the plan toolbar (DataGrip, IDE 2026.1+)

rows.label: Django AI actions
rows.value: AI Actions menu in PyCharm: Create Django View / Admin / Serializer For Model and Custom Django Intention

rows.label: DB schema in chat
rows.value: Type @dbObject: then select a table or schema to attach it — improves SQL generation quality in DataGrip
